slides.say: A controlled input gets its value from state, so React always decides what it shows.
Pass value from state, and an on change that updates that state on every keystroke.
Value without on change makes a read only field, and React warns. Only want a starting value? Use default value instead.

slides.text: An input can’t switch between controlled and uncontrolled.
slides.say: And an input must stay either controlled or uncontrolled for its whole lifetime.
